notes: 來 is a Chinese purpose particle (in order to) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; 管 alone carries H4910 (משל, rule)

很 in 很好 is a Chinese intensifier with no Hebrew source — left unannotated; only 好 carries H2896 (טוב)
